subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add official model/session reconcile-reset commands, and should those commands report only by default or also clear explicit session, agent, and auth pins under scoped flags?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the gaps and current precedence, but it cannot choose compatibility semantics for persisted user selections, custom providers, generated model catalogs, and auth-profile pins.

options.title: Report-first reconcile and scoped reset
options.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as dry-run/report-first surfaces that preserve explicit pins by default and require narrow flags to clear them.

options.title: Diagnostics and doctor only
options.body: Keep runtime precedence unchanged and improve status, doctor, and config validation warnings for shadowed or invalid model refs without adding a new reset command.

options.title: Automatic precedence change
options.body: Automatically clear or override existing pins when defaults change, accepting a deliberate compatibility break for durable session or agent selections.

recommendation.title: Report-first reconcile and scoped reset
recommendation.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as dry-run/report-first surfaces that preserve explicit pins by default and require narrow flags to clear them.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses model CLI, provider routing, status, doctor, and persisted session/auth semantics where steipete has the strongest observed product-surface history.
